email.body1:
Cody, saw Daxko has been on an acquisition streak, broadening the fitness and wellness portfolio across new segments.

Rolling up that many products usually means more in-market accounts than the team can touch before reps ramp on the wider portfolio, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Daxko off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Cody, quick follow-up for Daxko.

With a wider portfolio to sell, the target list usually outruns the team's capacity to work it. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Daxko needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Cody, last bit of proof for your Daxko team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Daxko's reply rate likely compares to peer SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
